headline: Heat persists in northern India, monsoon influence fades in south
on_air: Good morning, viewers. Today, the heat continues to dominate northern India, with temperatures remaining high. In New Delhi, the temperature is 31.4°C, down slightly from yesterday. Lucknow and Ahmedabad also see minor cooling, with Lucknow dropping to 28.2°C and Ahmedabad to 35.2°C. Tomorrow, New Delhi is expected to reach 32.1°C, while Lucknow and Ahmedabad will hover around 29.2°C and 35.6°C, respectively. The monsoon's influence is waning, as seen in Lucknow, where drizzle persists. In the south, Hyderabad and Chennai are experiencing clear skies, with Hyderabad reaching 34.1°C. Tomorrow, expect a slight increase in temperatures in Hyderabad to 34.1°C. Bangalore, too, will see a minor rise to 30.5°C. The air over New Delhi is moving towards Jaipur, while the air over Mumbai is heading towards Pune. Stay tuned for updates as we move into tomorrow. Good day to you all.
